caps.rule: Contract clamps total spin payout (grid + patterns + supernova incl. doubled picks) to 1000x wager.

cascades.note: Star symbols are never removed and persist through cascades.
cascades.rule: Winning minerals are removed; column gravity applies (survivors sink to the bottom of each column); new symbols drawn from base weights fill from the top. RNG consumed c=0..5, r=0..4. Repeat while there is any scatter win and steps < 2.

constellations.rule: After scatter evaluation of each cascade step, check fixed coordinate sets (col,row) on the 6x5 grid. If ALL cells of a pattern hold the SAME mineral (star/wild excluded), pay the pattern bonus. Only the HIGHEST matching pattern pays per step.

yunque.effect: +5% on tier-3 (12+) scatter pays only (patterns/supernova unaffected)

temple.effect: supernova pick prizes +10%, applied to the pick sum at settlement (prizes array stores base values)

crucible.rule: Every spin's TOTAL win (grid + patterns + supernova, in xbet units) adds essence to the crucible. Thresholds forge PERMANENT artifacts for the play session (persisted in localStorage; declared to the contract via gameData bitmask).

encoding.actionData: 6 raw bytes: [pick0..pick4, gambleFlag]. pickN in [0,11], all distinct. gambleFlag 0/1.
encoding.gameData: 1 raw byte: artifacts bitmask (bit0=brasa, bit1=yunque, bit2=temple). Contract validates <= 0x07.
encoding.gameState: abi.encode(Reveal struct): stage, gridWinBps, artifacts, prizes[12], grids (stepCount*30 bytes), stepWins[], stepPats[], stepCount, picksBps, picks[5], gambleWin, totalBps. All wins in bps of wager (10000 = 1x).

grid.indexing: column-major: index = col*5 + row; column c occupies indices c*5..c*5+4; row 0 = top

note: Single source of truth for math. The Solidity contract, the Python Monte Carlo simulator, and the frontend demo MUST implement these exact parameters. v2: supernova pick bonus replaced by NOVA FURNACE (automatic respin bonus, no picks, no gamble).

randomness.forbidden: never raw byte % n for n not dividing 256 (except n=2)
randomness.symbolDraw: uint16 rejection sampling: limit = floor(65536/122)*122 = 65514; reject v >= 65514; symbol = cumulative-weight lookup over 122

risk.heavyTail: maxPayout/wager = 1000 > 100 and probabilityWad 1e12 < 1e15 => tiered heavy-tail path applies
risk.probabilityWad: 1e12 (conservative over-estimate of the 1000x-cap event probability; true value far smaller; documented in RTP_MATH.md)

scatterPay.note: Final tuned paytable (integer bps in contract). Verified by Monte Carlo; see docs/RTP_MATH.md.
scatterPay.rule: 8+ of the same mineral anywhere on the grid pays. Tiers by count.

symbols.note: No wild symbol in the final design.

nova.name: NOVA FURNACE
nova.trigger: 3+ star symbols anywhere on the initial drop (stars in cascade refills do not retrigger)
nova.grid: 5x4 = 20 cells; every nova spin lands cores on empty cells

respin_mechanic.reset: every new core resets respins to 3
respin_mechanic.boosted_rule: Overdrive 2nd Chance: +2 respins and specials recharged on landing

core_types.value_granularity: 16-bit roll mapped onto cumulative weights (x50/x100 reachable)

specials.collector: on landing, fires beams to every existing core and absorbs their CURRENT values (copies, does not drain); can absorb specials
specials.payer: value x2; shockwave pays its value across 3-5 cores (may target specials)
specials.sniper: doubles up to 2 cores (may double specials)
specials.resolution_order: collector -> payer -> sniper, permitting explosive chains

nova.theoretical_max: unbounded raw (collector chains); payable capped at 1000x bet

charge.persistence: localStorage starforge-od-v1; reheat returns bar to 50%

wheel.heat_rule: mean of last 20 spin nets < 0 -> cold, else hot
wheel.spin: rigged: 5 full turns, easeOutQuart settle on the planned segment

winmult.base: mean of last 2 paid spins (xbet, can be 0)

second.effect: boosted nova furnace (+2 respins, specials recharged)

reheat.effect: charge back to 50% + 1 free spin at face value
